source_id.Description: Patient number in bart.hdf5 (group names p<number>)

age.Description: Not given per patient; the article's Table 1 gives 5-year age bands per row without patient numbers

sex.Description: Not given per patient; cohort 5 female, 10 male (article, N = 15)

diagnosis.Description: Clinical indication (STN DBS for Parkinson's disease; article)

implant_type.Description: Per dataset: single-channel tungsten microelectrode (Frederick Haer) used for STN localisation, or, in 7 datasets (16.2, 17.2, 18.1, 20.1, 22.1, 23.1, 30.1), a 32-channel Pt/Ir microwire array (35 µm, Ad-Tech) (paper Methods). Recording: Plexon MAP + FHC Guideline 4000.

n_lfp_channels.Description: Number of LFP channel tables in bart.hdf5 /meta/lfplist for this patient (summed over datasets). Job ieeg-b3enr-c-pearson-1007220748.

regions_sampled.Description: Paper: recordings in the STN (borders defined by single-unit mapping; 55/56 units within STN, one likely SNr).

recordings_detail.Description: Per dataset: LFP channel count (/meta/lfplist), sorted units (/meta/spklist), electrode type (paper).
